alerts.summary: RELEVANCE is no longer a sort key on these connections; a query that sorts by it must choose another key (Shopify says it acted as an ID sort).
alerts.quote: `RELEVANCE` will no longer be included in connection sort options by default as of `2025-04` API versions. This will eliminate cases where the option offered no unique behavior, and acted as a basic `ID` sort.

alerts.summary: Legacy shipping mode profiles are discontinued; their fields return static data and their mutations are no-ops, and the schema removes them in 2026-04. Remove the selections and arguments.
alerts.quote: Support for legacy mode profiles in shipping has been discontinued.

alerts.summary: inventorySetScheduledChanges is removed in 2026-07 with no replacement; code that schedules inventory changes needs another approach, such as immediate inventoryAdjustQuantities calls.
alerts.quote: mutation will be removed from the GraphQL Admin API in version `2026-07`. This mutation has no replacement, so any apps currently using it should stop relying on it to avoid disruptions.

alerts.summary: DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule is removed in 2026-10; select discountTitle and discountCode on the warning instead. The replacement is two scalar fields, not the PriceRule object.
alerts.quote: Update any query that reads `priceRule` from this warning to select `discountTitle` and `discountCode` instead.

alerts.summary: Removing DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule removes the PriceRule object and its related types from the 2026-10 schema; fragments and variables that name them stop validating.
alerts.quote: As a result, removing `priceRule` also removes the `PriceRule` object and its related types from the public schema in `2026-10` and later.

alerts.summary: FulfillmentService.permitsSkuSharing is removed in 2026-04 and SKU sharing is on for every fulfillment service; remove reads of the field and logic that assumed a single stocking location.
alerts.quote: Remove any reads/writes of `permitsSkuSharing` from your code for the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases.

alerts.summary: ignoreCompareQuantity is removed in 2026-04; an input that sent ignoreCompareQuantity: true opts out of the check by sending changeFromQuantity: null on each quantity instead.
alerts.quote: Now, to bypass comparison checks, you explicitly pass `null` to the `changeFromQuantity` field.

alerts.summary: From 2026-04, inventoryAdjustQuantities, inventoryMoveQuantities, inventorySetOnHandQuantities and productVariantsBulkUpdate quantity adjustments fail at runtime unless each change sends changeFromQuantity (the expected quantity, or null to opt out); the schema does not mark it required.
alerts.quote: This is a breaking change. Note that even though the `changeFromQuantity` field doesn't show up as mandatory at the schema level, calling these mutations without passing in `null` or passing in the current actual quantity will result in an error at runtime.

alerts.summary: fulfillmentOrderCancel userErrors change type to FulfillmentOrderCancelError with a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderCancel` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderCancelError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: fulfillmentOrderMove userErrors change type to a specific error type with a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderMove` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderMoveUserError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: collectionReorderProducts userErrors change type to CollectionReorderProductsUserError, which adds a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: Starting with version 2025-10, the `userErrors` GraphQL type in the GraphQL Admin API's [`collectionReorderProducts`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/collectionReorderProducts) mutation will be updated to `CollectionReorderProductsUserError`.

alerts.summary: From 2026-07, customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate requires the gateway payment method identifier on Stripe, Authorize.net and Braintree inputs; a call that omits it fails validation.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2026-07, the payment method identifier field is now required

alerts.summary: Explicit metafield access grants no longer work and their schema members are removed; code that reads or sets grants must use the definition access settings instead.
alerts.quote: existing explicit grants in the system will stop working on February 24, 2025.

alerts.summary: draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout is deprecated and removed in 2026-01; Shopify names draftOrderComplete instead, which takes different arguments.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2025-07, the `draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout` mutation has been deprecated. Please use the `draftOrderComplete` mutation instead.

alerts.summary: These PriceListUserErrorCode values are never returned and are removed from the schema; code that compares against them should drop those branches.
alerts.quote: Starting in API version 2025-04, [PriceListErrorCode](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/enums/PriceListUserErrorCode) values that are currently not returned by the API will be hidden.

alerts.summary: SubscriptionMailingAddress is replaced by MailingAddress on subscription delivery methods; fragments on SubscriptionMailingAddress must target MailingAddress.
alerts.quote: As of the 2025-07 version of the GraphQL Admin API, we've deprecated the [`SubscriptionMailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/SubscriptionMailingAddress) object. Use the [`MailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/MailingAddress) object instead.

alerts.summary: Collections move from one ruleSet to a multi-source model in 2026-07; collections that use new features are hidden from older versions. Migrating rule sets to sources is a model change, not a rename.
alerts.quote: The 2026-07 release replaces a collection’s single `ruleSet` with a multi-source model in the GraphQL Admin API.

alerts.summary: metafieldInteger collection conditions are removed in 2027-01; metafieldInt replaces them, and its value changes type from Int to String, so literals must change too.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2027-01`, the `metafieldInteger` collection source condition inputs and types is removed from GraphQL Admin API. If you use `metafieldInteger` to create or read collection source conditions, you need to migrate to `metafieldInt` before you upgrade to API version `2027-01`.

alerts.summary: Cumulative marketing engagements are deprecated and isCumulative defaults to false; integrations must send daily, non-cumulative metrics.
alerts.quote: The `isCumulative` argument to the `marketingEngagementCreate` mutation is being deprecated, defaulting to `false`. Please update your integration to send non-cumulative engagements, as needed.

alerts.summary: EventBridge and Pub/Sub webhook mutations and the callbackUrl filter are deprecated for webhookSubscriptionCreate/Update and the uri field, which take a different input shape (and uri is a String, not a URL).
alerts.quote: Use the new `uri` field in [`webhookSubscriptionCreate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/mutations/webhookSubscriptionCreate)/[`webhookSubscriptionUpdate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/mutations/webhooksubscriptionupdate) mutations and [`webhookSubscriptions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/queries/webhooksubscriptions) query instead of the deprecated endpoint-specific mutations and [`callbackUrl`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/queries/webhooksubscriptions#arguments-callbackUrl) field.

alerts.summary: GiftCardCreateInput.initialValue is deprecated for initialAmount, which is a MoneyInput rather than a Decimal, so the value must be rewritten with its currency.
alerts.quote: If your app creates gift cards directly, migrate from the deprecated `initialValue` field to `initialAmount`.

alerts.summary: ProductVariant.barcode is deprecated for the barcodes connection and input; barcode still reads and writes the first barcode, but the replacement is a list, not a rename.
alerts.quote: `ProductVariant.barcode` is now deprecated, but nothing breaks today and `barcode` keeps working:

alerts.summary: OrderTransaction.authorizationCode is deprecated for paymentId, which returns a Shopify identifier rather than the provider value, so stored values and reconciliation must change too.
alerts.quote: **Warning:** `paymentId` returns a Shopify-specific identifier, which differs from the provider-specific value in `authorizationCode`. Ensure your systems are updated to store and reconcile using this new ID format.

alerts.summary: InventoryItem.variant is deprecated for the variants connection, so selections need first:, edges or nodes rather than a rename.
alerts.quote: The `InventoryItem.variant` field has been deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. Use the new `InventoryItem.variants` connection instead.

alerts.summary: functionId inputs are deprecated for functionHandle, the handle in shopify.extension.toml; the value differs, so the code must send the handle instead of a looked-up ID.
alerts.quote: All GraphQL mutations that currently accept `functionId` will accept `functionHandle`.

alerts.summary: MetaobjectAdminAccess PRIVATE and PUBLIC_READ are deprecated and never returned; code that sends or compares them should stop.
alerts.quote: by deprecating the `PRIVATE` and `PUBLIC_READ` values. These values are now obsolete and are never returned by the API.

alerts.summary: marketCurrencySettingsUpdate already fails every request and is removed in 2027-01; pass currency settings to marketCreate or marketUpdate instead.
alerts.quote: As of GraphQL Admin API version `2027-01`, the `marketCurrencySettingsUpdate` mutation is removed

alerts.summary: returnRefund and Return.suggestedRefund are deprecated for returnProcess and suggestedFinancialOutcome, which combine disposition and refunds in one call with a different input.
alerts.quote: mutation is deprecated and replaced by the new [`returnProcess`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/returnProcess) mutation. The [`returnProcess`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/returnProcess) mutation streamlines return lifecycle management by combining disposition decisions and financial processing into a single call.

alerts.summary: FeeSale.fee is nullable from 2025-07 when the fee was deleted; code that reads it must handle null.
alerts.quote: As of 2025-07, the `FeeSale.fee` field is now nullable, meaning a `Fee` can be null if it has been deleted.

alerts.summary: On shops that use market-driven shipping, merchant-owned delivery profile reads may be stale and writes do not change live shipping; app-owned profiles are unaffected.
alerts.quote: When a shop uses market-driven shipping, the legacy delivery profile fields and mutations in the Admin GraphQL API no longer represent the shop’s live merchant-owned shipping configuration. Reads may return a stale snapshot of the legacy configuration, and writes may succeed without errors but will not update the merchant’s live shipping settings.

alerts.summary: orderCancel(refund:) is deprecated for refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund, a nested input rather than a renamed argument.
alerts.quote: If you want to continue to issue refunds to the original payments methods on order cancellation, replace your usages of the [`refund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refund) with the new [`refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refundMethod.fields.originalPaymentMethodsRefund) going forward.

alerts.summary: ShopPlan.displayName is deprecated for publicDisplayName, which returns a standardized set of names (Shopify is now Grow), so values differ.
alerts.quote: Please note that the `displayName` field will be deprecated in the future. We recommend updating your applications to use the `publicDisplayName` field to ensure compatibility with future updates.

alerts.summary: Cart tax and duty amounts are deprecated with no replacement; they are calculated at checkout.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2025-01`, we're deprecating the [tax and duty](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2024-01/objects/Cart#field-cost) fields in Storefront API Cart. Tax and Duties are calculated at Checkout where they can be finalized with the complete context of the buyer's information, ensuring greater accuracy.

alerts.summary: Cart buyer identity deliveryAddressPreferences is deprecated (and removed from the input in 2025-01) for CartDelivery.addresses and the cartDeliveryAddresses mutations, a different shape.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2025-01, the [`deliveryAddressPreferences`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/objects/CartBuyerIdentity#field-deliveryaddresspreferences) field on the `CartBuyerIdentity` object is deprecated. Use the new [`addresses`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/objects/CartDelivery#field-addresses) field on the `CartDelivery` object instead.

alerts.summary: Cart.discountAllocations and discountApplication on cart discount allocations are deprecated; sourceDiscountApplication returns the configured value rather than the per-line amount, so totals computed from value change.
alerts.quote: field is deprecated. Use `sourceDiscountApplication` instead. Note: the `value` field on `discountApplication` incorrectly returns the per-line allocated amount rather than the configured discount amount (for example, a $10 fixed discount allocated as $4 to one line shows `value: $4`). The new `sourceDiscountApplication` field returns the correct value.

alerts.summary: ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION is no longer emitted and is removed from the inventory user error codes in 2026-10; code that compares against it should drop that branch.
alerts.quote: If your app currently handles `ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION`, you can safely remove any logic that depends on this specific error.

alerts.summary: Market.currencySettings is nullable from 2025-04; null means the settings are inherited from the parent market, so readers must handle null.
alerts.quote: is now nullable. A null value indicates that the currency settings are inherited from the parent market.

alerts.summary: MarketWebPresence.market is deprecated and nullable because a web presence can belong to several markets or none; the markets connection replaces it, a list rather than a rename.
alerts.quote: A web presence can now exist without a market and can also be assigned to multiple markets. The field [`MarketWebPresence.market`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#field-market) is deprecated in favour of [`MarketWebPresence.markets`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#connection-markets), which allows for this expanded functionality.

alerts.summary: SellingPlanPercentagePriceAdjustment.adjustmentPercentage changes from Int to Float in 2025-01; code that assumes an integer percentage must accept fractions.
alerts.quote: This field, which facilitates the percentage price adjustment for a selling plan's pricing policy, will transition from an [`Int`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/scalars/Int) data type to a

alerts.summary: cartDiscountCodesUpdate requires the discountCodes argument from 2026-01; calls without it, which never changed the cart, now fail validation.
alerts.quote: the `cartDiscountCodesUpdate` mutation now requires the `discountCodes` argument to be included. Previously, mutation calls without the `discountCodes` argument were allowed, but would not actually modify the cart in any way.
